class.name: FmodVCA
class.brief_description: An FMOD Studio VCA (Volume Control Automation) for centralized volume control.
class.description:
FmodVCA is a volume multiplier that can affect multiple buses simultaneously without routing audio through it. VCAs are ideal for player-facing volume controls such as Master, Music, and SFX sliders.
Obtain a VCA with [method FmodServer.get_vca]: [codeblock] var master_vca = FmodServer.get_vca("vca:/Master") master_vca.set_volume(0.8) [/codeblock]

method.name: get_guid
method.description: Returns the GUID of this VCA as a string.

method.name: get_path
method.description: Returns the path of this VCA (e.g. [code]"vca:/Master"[/code]).

method.name: get_volume
method.description: Returns the current volume multiplier. [code]1.0[/code] is normal; [code]0.0[/code] is silent.

method.name: is_valid
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the underlying FMOD VCA handle is still valid.

method.name: set_volume
method.description: Sets the volume multiplier. [code]1.0[/code] is normal; [code]0.0[/code] is silent. Changes apply immediately to all buses connected to this VCA.
